Datadog also integrates with third-party tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, enabling centralized monitoring and automation. Its security and compliance features, including role-based access control, audit logging, and compliance certifications, ensure secure and compliant monitoring practices. These features contribute to cost reduction by minimizing tool redundancy and operational overhead, while improving efficiency through centralized visibility and automated workflows.
